flashMint.note: Verified: flashFee() returns 0 for DAI. Use ARRBY3156.sol against this lender instead of ARRBY.sol/Aave when the borrow asset is DAI — strictly cheaper.

_notes: aavePool is the single address that must be swapped per chain — everything else in the contract is identical bytecode.
Router addresses need only satisfy IV2Router (swapExactTokensForTokens + getAmountsOut) — any Uniswap-V2 fork works.

Chains without an Aave V3 deployment (e.g. very new L2s) can substitute a Balancer V2 Vault flash loan (0% fee) — same contract shape, swap IPool for IBalancerVault; ask if you want that variant generated.
Cross-reference / extend this file against your own chain registry at agenticplace.pythai.net/allchain.html — same JSON shape, more chains.
See integrations/chainmap_sync.js to sync this file from ALLCHAIN automatically once its data endpoint is confirmed.
